description:
DECISION (PRINCIPAL, 2026-05-22): beadwork stays on the CLI; do NOT wrap it in an MCP server.

RATIONALE: MCP tool definitions are always-loaded context overhead on every turn; CLI-via-Bash is leaner. Same context-cost logic that motivates the whole debloat. (Considered and rejected: MCP would have dissolved bw syntax footguns by encoding shape in the tool schema, but at a standing context cost.)

CONSEQUENCE: instruction + bw access reach EVERY tier via Bash - no Skill-tool grant, no MCP config, no depth-limit issue. This is why the composition layer delivers via bw/disk/dispatch rather than MCP.

bw-as-our-memory (PRINCIPAL framing): bw is a durable memory layer we built, whose sharing topology WE control (asymmetric visibility, operating-disciplines 7.1) - an advantage Anthropic's mechanisms (context, auto-memory, Skills) don't give, because they fix the sharing rules and we don't.
title: Decision: bw stays CLI, not MCP (context-cost); deliver instructions via bw/disk/dispatch
